boss_headers.name: Hogger
boss_headers.yell: Grrr... fresh meat!

boss_headers.name: Mother Fang
boss_headers.yell: Mother Fang skitters out of the mine!

boss_headers.name: Rhahk'Zor
boss_headers.yell: VanCleef pay big for your heads!

boss_headers.name: Mr. Smite
boss_headers.yell: We're under attack! Avast, ye swabs! Repel the invaders!

boss_headers.name: Edwin VanCleef
boss_headers.yell: Lapdogs, all of you!

boss_headers.name: Naraxis
boss_headers.yell: Naraxis drops from the branches!

boss_headers.name: Mor'Ladim
boss_headers.yell: You will join my army in death!

boss_headers.name: Stitches
boss_headers.yell: Stitches hungry! Stitches eat!

boss_headers.name: Lupos
boss_headers.yell: Lupos howls, and the Nightbane answer!

boss_headers.name: Morbent Fel
boss_headers.yell: The dead of Raven Hill rise at my command!

boss_headers.name: Doomguard Commander
boss_headers.yell: Your world is ours to burn!

boss_headers.name: Mannoroth's Herald
boss_headers.yell: Kneel before the Legion!

boss_headers.name: Varimathras
boss_headers.yell: The dreadlords remember Warsong. Do you?

boss_headers.name: Lord Hel'nurath
boss_headers.yell: Who dares summon Hel'nurath? Your soul is forfeit!

boss_headers.name: Lord Kazzak
boss_headers.yell: All mortals will perish!

boss_headers.name: Ravasaur Matriarch
boss_headers.yell: The Ravasaur Matriarch shrieks, and her pack answers!

boss_headers.name: Uhk'loc
boss_headers.yell: Uhk'loc beats his chest and charges!

boss_headers.name: Lar'korwi
boss_headers.yell: Lar'korwi comes for whoever took her eggs!

boss_headers.name: Tyrant Devilsaur
boss_headers.yell: The ground shakes as a Tyrant Devilsaur bursts from the trees!

boss_headers.name: King Mosh
boss_headers.yell: King Mosh roars, and the whole crater falls silent.

boss_headers.name: Kovork
boss_headers.yell: Kovork crush little ones! Basin belong to Boulderfist!

boss_headers.name: Nimar the Slayer
boss_headers.yell: Your head will hang in Witherbark Village!

boss_headers.name: Marez Cowl
boss_headers.yell: The Syndicate thanks you for your sacrifice.

boss_headers.name: Lord Falconcrest
boss_headers.yell: The Basin was always Alterac's. We are only taking it back.

boss_headers.name: Lord Aliden Perenolde
boss_headers.yell: Alterac will rise again, and the Highlands will kneel to it!

boss_headers.name: Zevrim Thornhoof
boss_headers.yell: Your blood will feed the forest's corruption!

boss_headers.name: Alzzin the Wildshaper
boss_headers.yell: The wilds will consume you!

boss_headers.name: Tendris Warpwood
boss_headers.yell: Who disturbs the Warpwood?

boss_headers.name: Immol'thar
boss_headers.yell: Immol'thar breaks free of its prison!

boss_headers.name: King Gordok
boss_headers.yell: Me smash! You die!

boss_headers.name: High Priestess Jeklik
boss_headers.yell: Lord Hir'eek, grant me wings of vengeance!

boss_headers.name: High Priest Venoxis
boss_headers.yell: Let the coils of hate unfurl!

boss_headers.name: Bloodlord Mandokir
boss_headers.yell: I'll feed your souls to Hakkar himself!

boss_headers.name: Jin'do the Hexxer
boss_headers.yell: Welcome to da great show, friends. Step right up to die!

boss_headers.name: Hakkar the Soulflayer
boss_headers.yell: PRIDE HERALDS THE END OF YOUR WORLD. COME, MORTALS! FACE THE WRATH OF THE SOULFLAYER!

boss_headers.name: Houndmaster Loksey
boss_headers.yell: Release the hounds!

boss_headers.name: Arcanist Doan
boss_headers.yell: You will not defile these mysteries!

boss_headers.name: Herod
boss_headers.yell: Ah, I've been waiting for a real challenge!

boss_headers.name: Scarlet Commander Mograine
boss_headers.yell: Infidels! They must be purified!

boss_headers.name: High Inquisitor Whitemane
boss_headers.yell: Mograine has fallen? You shall pay for this treachery!

boss_headers.name: Korrak the Bloodrager
boss_headers.yell: Korrak smash puny ones!

boss_headers.name: Ivus the Forest Lord
boss_headers.yell: Who disturbs the slumber of the forest?

boss_headers.name: Lokholar the Ice Lord
boss_headers.yell: I am the Ice Lord. Your blood will freeze in your veins!

boss_headers.name: Glacius the Frozen Titan
boss_headers.yell: The mountain remembers. The mountain will bury you!

boss_headers.name: Azuregos
boss_headers.yell: This place is under my protection. The mysteries of the arcane shall remain inviolate!

boss_headers.name: General Angerforge
boss_headers.yell: Dark Iron! To arms! Crush the intruders!

boss_headers.name: Warchief Rend Blackhand
boss_headers.yell: Blackrock will never fall! For the true Horde!

boss_headers.name: Emperor Dagran Thaurissan
boss_headers.yell: Come to aid the Throne!

boss_headers.name: Majordomo Executus
boss_headers.yell: Reckless mortals! None may challenge the sons of the living flame!

boss_headers.name: Nefarian
boss_headers.yell: Well done, my minions. The mortals' courage begins to wane! Now let's see how they contend with the true Lord of Blackrock Spire!

boss_headers.name: Kurinnaxx
boss_headers.yell: The sands erupt as Kurinnaxx surfaces!

boss_headers.name: General Rajaxx
boss_headers.yell: Impudent fool! I will kill you myself!

boss_headers.name: Princess Huhuran
boss_headers.yell: Princess Huhuran goes into a frenzy!

boss_headers.name: Ossirian the Unscarred
boss_headers.yell: Sands of the desert, rise and block out the sun!

boss_headers.name: C'Thun
boss_headers.yell: YOU ARE ALREADY DEAD.

boss_headers.name: Anub'Rekhan
boss_headers.yell: Ahh... welcome to my parlor.

boss_headers.name: Noth the Plaguebringer
boss_headers.yell: Glory to the master!

boss_headers.name: Patchwerk
boss_headers.yell: Patchwerk want to play!

boss_headers.name: Sapphiron
boss_headers.yell: Sapphiron rises from the frozen lair, its wings filling the hall with frost!

boss_headers.name: Kel'Thuzad
boss_headers.yell: Your petty magics are no challenge to the might of the Scourge!
